owned_weapon.primary: Damaged long sword taken from the Goa guardhouse by bribing Hank; source says it belonged to Shimotsuki Ryouma and was confiscated from a pirate. Current scene has Su Xiao preferring cold weapons and negotiating/acting with this sword.
owned_weapon.observed_properties: sid9 panel reports condition 35/40, Strength 2/Dexterity 5 requirements, and a fear/shock effect on enemies. It is not his later named Dragon Flash/Sword Mage state.
owned_weapon.other_stock: A low-condition flintlock was collected earlier and put in his own inventory; the text confirms it cannot be taken out of Van Pease. At sid20 he has tiger claw and a small Soul Crystal in inventory after opening the tiger chest. Exact cash and currently worn arrangement are not re-displayed at this cutoff.

talent_and_fuel.talent: Soul Eater was forcibly awakened at entry; kill notices are already demonstrated. After the Goa guard-chief kill the notice reports mana-cap gains and max 76 (sid11 p11-17); after the Mount Kolubo tiger it reports +15 and max 91 (sid16 p45-50).
talent_and_fuel.world_source: The same tiger notice reports 3.2% and total 8.9% World Source. Source data says king assassination itself yields no World Source; 8.9% remains the later settlement display, so its exact live pre-settlement readout at sid20 is inferred, not re-displayed there.
talent_and_fuel.mana_use: At sid11 he explicitly does not know how to use mana; no mana-powered technique/spell is demonstrated by sid20. Current spendable amount is not displayed in the cutoff scene. Do not turn mana into free unlimited combat fuel or a universal system currency.

acquired_items: Dead Wife's Necklace from the guard-chief chest, Strength +1; worn and then visually hidden while its effect remains (sid11 p40-72).
A second +1 Strength necklace from the Mount Kolubo white chest is reported at sid16 p62; exact worn/display state at sid20 is not re-shown.
Tiger teeth taken as the noble's bargain proof; his guard-chief appointment follows (sid18 p3-15).
The later green tiger chest has a small Soul Crystal and Tiger's Claw; he stores these in his inventory at sid20 (sid20 p69-104).
actor_state_at_sid20.authority_and_relationships: At sid20 the guard-chief appointment is active and he has hundreds of guards available outside the Krieg meeting; the appointment is a Paradise-enforced bargain after he brings tiger teeth. Hank is a wary subordinate/contact, not an automatic trusted companion. Su Xiao dismisses Oki's cronies and sends the guards back to headquarters after the meeting; authority is real but he does not control the whole institution as a free action.
actor_state_at_sid20.private_plan_and_knowledge: Su Xiao privately intends to kill Philip Herbert tonight, independent of whether the dump-burning plan succeeds. He predicts palace guards can be drawn toward a strong enemy; he arranges Krieg's crew to burn the Gray Terminal tomorrow at 18:00, promising equipment and noble status, while understanding the king intends to exploit the pirates and may not honor the offer. He has disclosed limited terms to Krieg/Gin, and assigned Hank an unspecified important task. These beliefs/knowledge are not automatically available to the parallel player.
